shared_replacements.added_text: **局部对齐与共同破坏 / Local alignment and collective destruction，2026-10-08。** [本会话研究](COLLECTIVE-DESTRUCTIVE-ATTRACTORS.md)保留第一构造32项定理／41项审计，新增71项定理／100项审计，连接有限人口替换、内部筹资、真实材料约束接续与恢复／耗尽的精确分界。/ Faster revision can remove the contributors needed to finance correction; an initial reserve transfer can reverse the outcome. old_M24.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
old_M24.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。
old_M24.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct.
old_M24.scope_zh: 原47项 Lean 定理／65项审计保留；新40项定理／69项审计（另54项继承审计）接通不同产出承载者、材料、实际探测、修复及后续核心轨迹。1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算保留。正确识别不保证还能回应，等待也可能改善可恢复探测。理论探索已到被动历史不足以辨认回返来源的边界；经验对应仍须在具体应用中检验，无普遍预警分数或独立验收主张。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。实际人口分配／替换与纠正的共同接续仍开放。
old_M24.scope_en: The first 47 Lean theorems / 65 audits are preserved; 40 new theorems / 69 new audits, with 54 inherited audits separate, connect varied carrier yields, material, executed probing, repair and subsequent core traces. The 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations retain their scope. Correct identification need not preserve response capacity; waiting can enable recoverable probing. The theoretical exploration reaches a passive-identification limit. Field correspondence remains application-specific; no universal warning score or independent acceptance is claimed. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. Actual population allocation/replacement composed with correction remains open.
